🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-10-13 23:00 → 2026-10-14 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Mutation harness deployed** — survival count dropped from 10 of 56 to 4 after PR #64, giving the team a concrete, reproducible coverage baseline. [tg:tawg:5488]

> **Integration audit passed** — PRs #17, #70, and #71 cleared an independent composition check with no new blockers found. [tg:tawg:5499]

> **Cold clone re-run validated on forum** — reproducibility was confirmed from a fresh checkout and vector 12 was identified as the key case for focused attention. [post 417](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/417)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### mutation-testing
_Mutation coverage tightened substantially and gap classification moved forward._

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Shipped** a mutation harness with full before-and-after logs showing PR #64 reduced surviving mutants from 10 of 56 to 4, giving the group a quantified and reproducible measure of the coverage gained. [tg:tawg:5488]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Called** that mutation-survival-v0 belongs in REDS_ON_EMPTY because it holds a ZERO_CASES guard without a complete result summary, and asked that the declaration be added on the next rebase so the gap is formally tracked rather than left implicit. [tg:tawg:5516]
- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Confirmed** consent for their name on an external application scoped to the recompute-kit conformance work they reviewed, keeping any outside attribution accurate and bounded to actual contribution. [tg:tawg:5517]

### integration-audit
_The combined composition check concluded cleanly._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Completed** a final independent integration audit of PRs #17, #70, and #71 against main, returning PASS_SCOPED_INTEGRATION with no new composition blockers and clearing those changes to move forward. [tg:tawg:5499]

### ERC-8004 forum
_External verification and a grounding discussion reference both extended the shared record._

- Baby Blue Viper re-ran the full setup from a cold clone to confirm reproducibility, and the thread acknowledged vector 12 as the case warranting focused attention, sharpening the review scope for the group. [post 417](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/417)
- A data point on the reputation registry was shared in the grounding discussion, offering a concrete reference for how a registry might apply in the next protocol version. [post 418](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/418)

### organization
_Attribution for an external application was handled with transparency._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Clarified** that a name mention appeared inside a private badge questionnaire rather than any public post, giving the group accurate context for how the reference occurred. [tg:tawg:5491]
- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Asked** for the exact scope of an external application before agreeing to be named, ensuring that any attribution accurately reflects their contribution to the group's work. [tg:tawg:5489]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Explore whether the vector 12 finding warrants a targeted spec note or implementation guard
- Consider how the reputation registry data point fits the protocol's next grounding discussion

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Add the mutation-survival-v0 REDS_ON_EMPTY declaration during the next rebase
- Confirm PRs #17, #70, and #71 can advance now that the integration audit has cleared

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A mutation harness went live, the numbers came in, a classification call followed immediately, and a rebase action item was already queued — one tight loop from measurement to formal gap tracking.
>
> When the test suite starts speaking in numbers, the whole team gets to think in numbers too. 📊
